description: This source file defines the RawEncoding class, a custom encoding implementation for raw string processing within the PDFsharp library. It provides methods for encoding and decoding strings where each character directly maps to a byte, suitable for raw byte string representation in PDFs.

classes.name: RawEncoding
classes.description: A sealed class inheriting from Encoding, providing raw byte encoding and decoding functionalities for PDF string processing.

methods.name: RawEncoding
methods.description: Constructor for the RawEncoding class, initializes a new instance.

methods.name: GetByteCount
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes that will result from encoding a specified set of characters.

methods.name: GetBytes
methods.description: Encodes a set of characters into bytes using raw encoding, assuming characters are within 0-255.

methods.name: GetCharCount
methods.description: Returns the count of characters produced by decoding a sequence of bytes.

methods.name: GetChars
methods.description: Decodes bytes into characters assuming a direct mapping.

methods.name: GetMaxByteCount
methods.description: Calculates the maximum number of bytes needed to encode a specified number of characters.

methods.name: GetMaxCharCount
methods.description: Calculates the maximum number of characters produced by decoding a specified number of bytes.
